title: Spain investigates deadly high-speed train crash
caption:
At least 69 people died when a Renfe high-speed train hit a stopped Iryo train near Urda, south of Madrid. 544 passengers were on board both trains. It is Europe's deadliest rail crash since 2013. Investigators are looking at a safety-system failure that happened minutes before the collision.
